surfaces.notes:
Git: unmodified, renderless (service-rendered through CoarOverlayOutlet). Exact contract (read): useContextMenu.open() records event.target when it is an Element; CoarContextMenu passes it as the overlay `context`; overlay-service sets contextEl = options.context ?? anchorEl ?? parent panel. A programmatic open({clientX, clientY}) has no target and a virtual anchor has no anchorEl, so no local opt-in can be resolved and the menu opens in the legacy presentation - the documented API boundary (Preview, useContextMenu.ts:13-18), unit-tested for a non-element target (CoarContextMenu.test.ts), not a claimed bug.
